business_overview.one_sentence: The group is principally engaged in licensing, distribution and sale of footwear products and accessories in Mainland China, with meaningful rental income from Mainland China investment properties.

segments.name: Sales of goods
segments.note: Wholesale plus retail sales of footwear goods

business_overview.revenue_model: Brand licensing fees from franchisees plus wholesale/retail footwear sales; 2023 revenue was concentrated, with top five customers accounting for about 84%.
business_notes: 87 physical shops and 601 online shops operated by franchisees at 2023 year-end; DAPHNE.LAB had 3 offline and 5 online directly managed stores.
Gross rental income from investment properties was RMB46.025m.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-cash impairment on Mainland investment properties

non_recurring_items.item: loss on disposal of investment properties
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Loss on disposal of investment properties

non_recurring_items.item: fair value gain on financial assets at FVPL
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair value gain on certificates of deposit / wealth management products

funds_assets.item: cash at banks and in hand
funds_assets.business_substance: Cash and cash equivalents; RMB306.194m was in Mainland China; currencies RMB331.284m, HK$25.566m equivalent, US$9.423m equivalent

funds_assets.item: financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
funds_assets.business_substance: Certificates of deposit from Mainland commercial banks, fixed rates 3.0%-3.8%, tradable before maturity; longest maturity 2026-06-02

operating_assets.business_substance: Trade customer receivables, 30-60 day credit period
Leasehold improvements, equipment and motor vehicles

investment_assets.business_substance: Mainland China investment properties, leased to third parties; aggregate fair value disclosed as RMB713.377m

other_assets.business_substance: VAT recoverable, deposits, rental receivables, prepayments and others

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Lease liabilities for offices, warehouses and stores; current RMB5.834m, non-current RMB3.451m
Convertible notes matured and fully converted on 16 October 2023

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Deposits received, accruals, employee benefits, receipts in advance and taxes
Non-refundable advances and rebates to be settled by goods only

years.source: Annual Report 2023 five-year summary and cash flow statement
Annual Report 2023 income and cash flow statements

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2022-2023 operating cash flow was well above reported profit and capex was small, but 2023 profit includes bank interest, FVTPL gains and investment-property rental economics; customer concentration and newly opened direct stores reduce certainty.

evidence.source: HKEXnews Annual Report 2023, p.4-5 / financial highlights and five-year summary
evidence.note: Revenue, operating profit, parent profit, cash and comparative profit data.

evidence.source: HKEXnews Annual Report 2023, p.63-68 / consolidated income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement

evidence.note: Revenue split, other income/losses, leases, FVTPL deposits, cash location/currency, convertible notes and cash-flow reconciliation.

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by parent company versus individual subsidiaries/VIE; only Mainland China location and currency split is disclosed.
No explicit restricted-cash line was found; pledged assets were disclosed as nil, but absence of a separate restricted cash note is treated conservatively through haircut and operating-cash reserve.
Three-year operating cash flow and capex were not fully extracted from separate 2021 annual report in this run; 2021 profit came from the five-year summary.
